history.introSubtitle: A living pilgrimage town — lakeside aarti, the Brahma temple, and desert light that has welcomed seekers for centuries.

h1.title: The sacred lake
h1.body: Legend holds that Pushkar Lake rose from a lotus petal of Lord Brahma. Pilgrims have bathed here for millennia seeking purification and blessings.

h2.title: Brahma’s rare shrine
h2.body: Pushkar is home to one of the few temples dedicated to Brahma. Its white spire and silver face remain a quiet center of devotion amid the bustling bazaar.

h3.title: Ghat aarti & festivals
h3.body: Evening aarti on the ghats, Kartik Fair, and seasonal rituals keep the town’s spiritual rhythm alive — lamps, bells, and desert dusk.

h4.title: Pushkar Tour
h4.body: We host travelers who want authenticity without friction: priests you can trust, stays with soul, and journeys paced for wonder — booked simply on WhatsApp.
